plan: Final experiment design delivered in formal scientific design-document tone, organized as the requested (a)–(j) sections: (a) one-paragraph question restatement; (b) three directional pre-registered hypotheses H1 (overall SSP ASR reduction), H2 (token-level ASR reduction: GCG + AutoDAN), H3 (prompt-level ASR reduction: PAIR + template ensemble), with α'=0.05/3 Bonferroni per test and exploratory E1–E3 held outside the budget; (c) full design matrix Model ∈ {Vicuna-7B-v1.5, Llama-2-7B-Chat, Llama-3-8B-Instruct}, two SSP levels (Without-SSP = empty system field cross-vendor; With-SSP = Canonical Safety Reminder Block v1), attack families, prompt sets (AdvBench 520 primary; HarmBench 100 and JBB-BeaverTails 100 cross-validation; 60 benign controls), and decoding (greedy primary + single documented stochastic sensitivity); (d) full frozen SSP texts for both conditions and a note that a 'reinforced' arm is only an optional extension; (e) registered GCG (white-box, 500 steps, suffix transferred from 50 → 470 prompts, 3 seeds), AutoDAN (200-generator genetic, 50 → 470 transfer), PAIR (Vicuna-13B attacker, Llama-Guard judge, 20-iteration cap), and 6-item template ensemble parameters; (f) dual-judge protocol (refusal-keyword classifier + LLM judge) with third-judge arbitration, fallback rule, PARTIAL handling, and mandatory 20–30-item calibration set with Cohen's κ gating rule; (g) Wilson 95% CIs, paired McNemar per (model × attack) cell on the same prompts across SSP on/off, matched-pair odds ratios with 95% CIs, Forest-style summary, mixed-effects logistic-regression exploratory analyses, and a-priori power note with min-detectable-OR rule; (h) explicit controls (fixed decoding, prompt-order randomization, judge blinding, benign-prompt over-refusal control, positive-control jailbreaks per attack family, direct baseline, calibration) and threats-to-validity table; (i) compute/time feasibility budget ≈ 1,640 GPU-hours on 2× A100 with a registered scope-reduction ordering; (j) limitations and a 17-item pre-registration checklist. The reinforced-SSP arm is marked as an optional extension only and not in the registered family.

context.question: Does incorporating a Safety System Prompt (SSP) significantly enhance the robustness of Large Language Models (LLMs) against jailbreak attacks? Specifically, how does the presence of SSP influence the Attack Success Rate (ASR) under both token-level and prompt-level attacks?
context.context: Design an experiment that answers the question. The researcher can clarify source-supported setup details by topic. Do not claim that an experiment was run.
